results.name: dvd_mul_right
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem dvd_mul_right (a b : α) : a ∣ a * b :=
  Dvd.intro b rfl

results.name: mul_dvd_mul_right
results.source_text:
theorem mul_dvd_mul_right (h : a ∣ b) (c : α) : a * c ∣ b * c := by
  gcongr

results.name: DomMulAct
results.source_text:
/-- If `M` multiplicatively acts on `α`, then `DomMulAct M` acts on `α → β` as well as some
bundled maps from `α`. This is a type synonym for `MulOpposite M`, so this corresponds to a right
action of `M`. -/
@[to_additive /-- If `M` additively acts on `α`, then `DomAddAct M` acts on `α → β` as
well as some bundled maps from `α`. This is a type synonym for `AddOpposite M`, so this corresponds
to a right action of `M`. -/]
def DomMulAct (M : Type*) := MulOpposite M
results.docstring:

results.name: Fermion.Dirac.dualRight_add
results.source_text:
@[simp]
lemma dualRight_add (d₁ d₂ : Dirac) : (d₁ + d₂).dualRight = d₁.dualRight + d₂.dualRight := rfl
